title: Arriving in Pensacola: Joe Wynn's backers and Prince Morris's rival band
summary: Wynn broke from Prince Morris and teamed with a doctor and Aaron Long, who ran Morris Park; Sayles finds Lee Collins's band there and Wynn lures Edmund Hall and Albert Morgan into the New Orleans group.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: well we didn't leave yo no with no bass that's what we left yo with so when we got there I'm gonna tell you how the band formed up we found out that Joe Wynn had been working for a guy color color named Morris which had an undertaker and he had been hiring bands over there but he was crooked with that band Joe Wynn broke away from him and got with a doctor I think the doctor was named Dr. Brunwick or something colored doctor and there was another man colored man named Aaron Long he had a meat market and Aaron Long had a and those were businessmen like I said Dr. Brunwick he had his drug store and Aaron Long had a meat market and had another man had a grocery store I can't think of his name there was a corporation those guys I found out owned and run what they call the Morris Park in Pensacola it was right on the out outskirt of the city it was a baseball park and they also owned a baseball team because they had a lot of good colored baseball team in towns like Pensacola Mobile and Montgomery in those times and so when we came when we got to Pensacola we found that's where I found Lee Lee Collins in this band listen to this band I was working for this guy Prince Morris that's what his name Joe Wynn had been working for him but Joe Wynn quit and they fell out they was already working with Prince Morris for Prince Morris rather and there was in this band was Lee Collins on trumpet Evan Hall on clarinet Alvin Morgan on bass and a guy named Caffrey on banjo and Williamson Brothers one played trombone

and I found it I wish I had known around there that Lee Collins and Oil were always good buddies and those guys had a real good Dixieland band so Joe Wynn liked to took a stole Edmund Hall from that group and took Alvin Morgan from that group and put them with us and we picked up on a piano player that lived in that town named Helen Jackson her mid name was Helen Jackson Goodreads no no before that I forgot there was another woman another woman played piano player I can't think of her name right now but we used it a while but some kind of way
